title: Understanding Regularization
text: Regularization is a technique used to prevent overfitting by adding a penalty term to the loss function. It helps in reducing the variance of the model.

title: Bias-Variance Tradeoff
text: The bias-variance tradeoff is a fundamental concept in machine learning. Regularization primarily affects the variance of the model.

title: Effect of Regularization on Bias
text: Does regularization increase or decrease the bias of a model?

title: Effect of Regularization on Variance
text: Does regularization increase or decrease the variance of a model?

title: Conclusion on Bias Squared
text: Since regularization increases bias and decreases variance, it does not reduce the bias squared of the model.
